_comment: Casters whose spell rows should be filled in, and the spells to bake into
the payload. The Mod script matches rows by spell name at run time, so this
spell list only decides what ends up in the file - extra names are harmless.
'innate' names a subset of 'casters' whose stat block says Innate
Spellcasting rather than Spellcasting; their rows get the sheet's small grey
innate marker next to the spell name.
'aliases' maps a Roll20 spell name onto its 5etools name where the two differ.
